body.text: Every prompt and file you paste into ChatGPT’s free plan gets stored to train its models.

body.text: Meta’s algorithm favors audiences that already know your brand, even if they’re small.
A 300-person list of past buyers often outperforms a 30k lookalike audience.

Start with a custom audience of website visitors or past buyers instead.

Focus on steady conversions, not a single big number—daily beats big budgets with gaps.

carousels.hook: Gmail ignores clever subject lines if your sender score is high
carousels.throughline: Gmail prioritizes sender reputation over subject lines—here’s how to build trust and land in the Primary tab.

reel_beats.hook: Gmail ignores your subject line if your sender score is high

body.text: Gmail’s filter cares more about who you are than what your subject line says.
A high sender score means your emails land in Primary, even with a weak subject.
Sender score is built on opens, replies, and how often people move you to Primary.
Encourage replies and moves to Primary—Gmail skips the spam folder entirely once your score is high.
